description: This source file defines the AuthorRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository for performing CRUD operations on Author entities, with additional methods for fetching authors with their associated books using entity graphs.

classes.name: AuthorRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for Author entity, providing methods for basic CRUD operations and custom queries with entity graph annotations.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds an author by ID, fetching associated books eagerly via entity graph.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all authors, including their books, using the entity graph.
